_about: Hand-checked requirements QuestieDB's WoW Forever data doesn't have, for quests the guide would otherwise send you to before the giver offers them. gen.py adds 'after' to the quest's prerequisites (all of them handed in first) and writes 'rep' as rn={faction name, lowest standing}: the add-on looks the faction up by name in your reputation list, because the data has no faction IDs for WoW Forever's new factions. Every entry names where it was checked (src). Add only what a source or an in-game check confirms.

<quest ID>.name: quest name, to read the file by
src: where it was checked

_barkskin: Barkskin Burrow (Mount Hyjal): the furbolgs start Hostile and won't talk to you; Brerufa's Balance Through Strength (93952) is the first quest, and handing it in lifts the standing to Unfriendly (Polestar's recording). Every other quest given in the burrow waits for that.
